development_only_input.use: candidate selection only; development numbers are not promotion evidence

candidate_policy.name: R3-RS
rules: Distinguish Oracle spell and ETB windows; source removal after the ETB trigger exists does not erase it.
Apply Defense Grid's additional three generic mana only to spells cast by players other than the active player.
Treat a live Vexing Bauble as a triggered counter for spells cast with no mana spent unless that trigger is answered.
Mindbreak Trap's free condition counts spells actually cast by RogSi, not storm copies or other players' spells.
Track Breach fuel exactly and never reuse the same graveyard card across escape payments.
Treat Phyrexian Tower as colorless unless a creature is actually sacrificed for BB; record that creature as spent.
Record Pact debt whenever Pact is used.

promotion_scope.if_pass: promote R3-RS as Race public-state timing/resource overlay only
promotion_scope.if_fail: reject R3-RS and return to development
